notes: Vimshottari mahadasha results by the natal condition of the dasha lord. Verses 3-4: a planet in the first, second or third decanate of its sign gives its results at the start, middle or end of its dasha (reversed if retrograde). Period words such as 'king' are rendered as government, authority or employer, following the translator's own glosses.

skipped.reason: Physical danger when Venus rules the 2nd or 7th (maraka) and remedial measures: excluded by the sensitive-topics policy.

rules.text: General rule: a dasha lord in the ascendant, exalted, in its own or a friend's sign, or joined or aspected by benefics gives favourable results, felt from the start of the period.
General rule: a dasha lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th house, debilitated, in an enemy's sign or combust gives unfavourable results.

Sun dasha with the Sun dignified in an angle, trine or the 11th: comfort and happiness, gains of wealth and profitable activity, high position granted by government or employer, authority and vehicles.

variants.text: The Sun's conjunction with the 9th or 10th lord strengthens this.
With the 5th lord: the birth of a child.
With the 11th lord: costly vehicles and comforts.
With the 4th lord: vehicles, wealth and a senior post through the favour of those in power.

rules.text: Sun dasha with the Sun weak (in the 6th, 8th or 12th, debilitated, or with malefics, the nodes or the lords of those houses): stress, loss of money and reputation, residence away from home, trouble with authority, friction with siblings and friends, worry for and about the parents, and undeserved public criticism.

variants.text: A benefic joins or aspects the Sun, so happy events come in between.

rules.text: Moon dasha with the Moon exalted, in its own sign, or bright in an angle or trine: happiness and auspicious events from beginning to end — gains of money and produce, celebrations at home, vehicles, fine clothes, success in work, favour from authority and friends, and joy through children.

variants.text: The Moon's conjunction with the 4th, 9th or 10th lord strengthens this.
In the 11th house and dignified: wealth in many forms, growth in fortune, happiness and education, and official commendation.
Moon dasha with a strong Moon in the 3rd: fluctuating results — comfort at some times, gains of money at others.
Moon dasha with a waning Moon joined by malefics: sluggishness and low mood, trouble at work, loss of money and difficulty through maternal relatives.
Moon dasha with a weak Moon in the 6th, 8th or 12th: blame from authority, mental tension, financial loss, friction with the mother and a heavy mood.
Moon dasha with a strong Moon in the 6th, 8th or 12th: mixed results, gains and happiness alternating with physical discomfort.

rules.text: Mars dasha with Mars dignified or well placed (angle, trine, 2nd or 11th) and strong: gains of money and produce, benefit and recognition from government or employer, vehicles, clothes and jewellery, residence abroad, and warmth from siblings. Comforts from spouse, children and status come at the start; some difficulty may be expected towards the end.

variants.text: Mars in the 3rd or an angle: wealth earned through sustained struggle, and victory over rivals.

rules.text: Mars dasha with Mars debilitated, or in a difficult house and joined or aspected by malefics: unfavourable results.

Rahu dasha with Rahu dignified, or in an angle, trine, 3rd or 11th under benefic influence: very favourable — wealth and prosperity, ambitions achieved through friends and government, a vehicle, a child, a new home, religious feeling, festivities, recognition abroad, and property and land through the favour of those in authority.
rules.note: The text gives Rahu's exaltation as Scorpio (or, by the more common view it also mentions, Taurus) and own sign as Aquarius; the engine uses Taurus and Aquarius.

rules.text: Rahu dasha with Rahu in the 8th or 12th, or tied to malefics: a painful period with changes of place and mental strain. The start brings physical stress and financial loss; the middle brings comfort and income from abroad; the end again brings distress, relocation and strain.

Jupiter dasha with Jupiter exalted, in its own sign, or in an angle, trine or the 11th: benefit and honours from government and authority, refined pleasures, vehicles and clothes, devotion and study of philosophy, success in undertakings, affection from spouse and children, marriage and births, and all-round prosperity.

Jupiter dasha with Jupiter debilitated, with malefics, or in the 8th or 12th: change of residence, mental tension, worry over children, vague fears, financial loss and pilgrimage. Difficulty at the start gives way to comfort, official recognition and splendour in the middle and last parts.

Saturn dasha with Saturn exalted, in its own or a friend's sign, or in the 3rd, 9th or 11th: recognition from government, growth of wealth, high status and command, the pleasure of learned discussion, prosperity at home, marriage and the birth of a child.

Saturn dasha with Saturn in the 6th, 8th or 12th, debilitated or combust: upheaval and change of place, fear and anxiety, distress to parents, spouse and children, conflict with the authorities and legal trouble.

variants.text: Saturn joined by a benefic or in Sagittarius or Pisces instead brings gains from authority, enthusiasm, and comforts of clothing and vehicles.

rules.text: Mercury dasha with Mercury exalted, in its own or a friend's sign, or in an angle or trine: happiness, wealth, prosperity and popularity, property, higher education and refinement, appreciation from those in authority, interest in good works, warmth from spouse and children, good health, contentment and business gains.

variants.text: With benefic influence or the 10th lord's, the dasha gives its full results.

rules.text: Mercury dasha with Mercury joined or aspected by malefics, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th: displeasure of authority, mental upset, friction with siblings and relatives, foreign travel, dependence on others, and erosion of income and property. The start still brings wealth, comforts and property, the middle brings official recognition, and the last part brings obstacles.

Ketu dasha with Ketu in an angle, trine, or the 3rd, 6th or 11th: favour from authority, an administrative role, vehicles, happiness from spouse and children, enjoyable travel at home and abroad, and the affection of friends. The start brings rise in position, the middle a spell of fear, and the end long-distance travel.
Ketu dasha with Ketu in the 2nd, 8th or 12th, joined or aspected by malefics: estrangement from siblings and relatives, loss of land or property, distress, and poor company.
Venus dasha with Venus exalted, in its own sign, or in an angle: elevation in rank, vehicles, clothes and ornaments, fine food, recognition from those in power, and a prosperous home.

variants.text: In a trine: high position, wealth, a house, celebrations at home, the children's welfare, command over others, and welcome visits from dear relatives.

rules.text: Venus dasha with Venus in the 6th, 8th or 12th or debilitated: quarrels with relatives, difficulty through women, losses in business, and distress to spouse and children.

Venus dasha with Venus ruling the 9th or 10th and placed in the ascendant or 4th: great happiness, an administrative position, a stirring of religious feeling expressed in building and giving, enthusiasm for work, and the comfort of status, wealth, assets, spouse and children.
